_comment: Klondike Solitaire locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. NEVER translate card labels/suits (e.g. A, 10, K, ♣️, ♦️, ♥️, ♠️), the pile tokens W, F1-F4, T1-T7, the ASCII board in {board}, or the commands 'draw', 'move', 'forfeit', 'all'. The bracket syntax like 'move W T1' must stay in Latin as-is.

_slots.{n}: Action index within a comma-separated command, 1-based
_slots.{msg}: A nested per-action result message (already localized)
_slots.{count}: Number of face-up cards being moved
_slots.{cmd}: The unknown command the player typed (not translated)
_slots.{max_turns}: The maximum number of turns before the game ends
_slots.{score}: Number of cards currently in the foundation piles
_slots.{stock}: Number of cards left in the stock
_slots.{waste}: The top waste card label, or '--' if empty (never translate)
_slots.{cards}: The cards in a pile as neutral labels, or '--' if empty (never translate)

player_prompt.intro: Mo yeke sala ngia ti Klondike Solitaire. Ye so mo ye ayeke ti gue na acarte kue na ndo molongo ti gere ni. Akpengba-ndia ti jeu: - Molongo ti gunda (F1-F4): Leke lege ti guengo na nduzu, a londo na Ace juska Gbia; A lingbi nga ti leke aye tongana tableau (T1-T7): Gbu li nde nde (vuko na ndö ti vuko, vuko na ndo ti bengba) - Stock: Tinda alettre si ala buba gbâ ti atênë; Waste (W): Kota carte so alingbi ti tene azo asala kua na ni Commandes: 'tinda' - Tirango alettere na place ti bata wala ti zi yâ ni; <source><destination> [count] - Yôro akireti na popo ti apile Exemple: 'Yö W1', 'Zia T1 F2', 'Zi T3 T5 2'. Peut duti nga "azo kue", so ayeke tara fade fade ti yôra akugbe so lê asigigi polele pëpe. - 'Ti tï na kuâ" - Hunzi angoi ti match na kanga iri ti mo laso - Piseau W (awâ), F4-F1-T1), Zua abate kuäle na ndo ni (T7-A).

format_error.no_brackets: A yeke nzoni a zia atënë ni na yâ ti acouche.
format_error.no_closing_bracket: A yeke na lege ni pëpe ti sara ye so a hunda. Kete kete tënë ayeke dä ape "]"
format_error.empty_command: Commande so ayeke senge. Mo lingbi ti sû "draw" wala "move <source><destination> [count]".
format_error.empty_action: Ye so a sara ni senge senge
format_error.move_needs_args: Komand ti yôro ahunda ndo so a londo dä nga na ndo ni si zo ague. A sala kusala na: 'move <source> <destination> [count]'
format_error.count_positive: A lingbi wungo ni aduti nzoni wala "azo kue"
format_error.count_invalid: A diko ni nzoni ape. Sara kua na mbeni wungo wala "azo kue"

action_result.before_failure: A sala {n} ye so a hunda ti sara kozoni si kpale asi.

move_result.drew: A zia ni na yâ ti mbeni ye so a bata.
move_result.cannot_draw: E lingbi ti gboto ye pëpe, e yeke na aye mingi nga a buba ni kue.
move_result.invalid_pile: Iri ti pile ni ayeke na lege ni pëpe. Sara kua na W, F1-F4, wala T1-T7
move_result.foundation_one_card: A lingbi ti zia gi carte oko na yâ da ni.
move_result.waste_to_foundation_ok: A zia carte ni na yâ ti aye so a buba F{dst}
move_result.waste_to_foundation_bad: A lingbi ti zia carte ni na ndo so a leke gere ni dä ape.
move_result.tableau_to_foundation_ok: Tɛ̈mɛ̈n kɛ̈ thia kɛn tableau T{src} de foundation F{dst}
move_result.tableau_to_foundation_bad: A lingbi ti yôro carte ni na ndo molongo so a zia gere ni dä pëpe
move_result.foundation_to_foundation: A lingbi ti gue na mbeni ndo nde pëpe.
move_result.waste_to_tableau_one_card: A lingbi ti zia gi carte oko na yâ tableau ni.
move_result.waste_to_tableau_ok: A zia carte ni na yâ ti tableau T{dst}
move_result.waste_to_tableau_bad: A lingbi ti zia carte ni na ndo tableau so ape.
move_result.no_face_up: A zia carte ni na nduzu pëpe ti tene a gue dä.
move_result.tableau_to_tableau_ok: Tɛ̈mɛ̈n {count} kɛ̈ thia kɛn tableau T{src} de T{dst}
move_result.tableau_to_tableau_bad: Kɛ̈ thia tiŋ {count} kɛ̈ thia kɛn T{src} de T{dst}
move_result.foundation_to_tableau_one_card: A lingbi ti zia gi carte oko na ndo so a leke ni dä si lo gue na place ni.
move_result.foundation_to_tableau_ok: Tɛ̈mɛ̈n kɛ̈ thia kɛn foundation F{src} de tableau T{dst}
move_result.foundation_to_tableau_bad: A lingbi ti zia carte na ndo tableau T{dst} pëpe.
move_result.to_waste_or_stock: A lingbi ti zia ni na ndo so a yeke buba aye dä pëpe wala na yâ ti akungba.

outcome.forfeit: A zia ngia ni na sese. Nduru wungo ti a-carte: {score} yâ ti acarte so ayeke tongana gere ti da (foundations).
outcome.won: E bara mo, mo sö benda na yâ ti molongo so a iri ni Klondike Solitaire!
outcome.turn_limit: Ŋɛ̈kɛ̈! Ya tɛ̈mɛ̈n tɛ̈mɛ̈n ɣɔn {max_turns}. Thia: {score} kɛ̈ thia kɛn foundation.

board.title: === KLONDIKE SOLITAIRE=== Aye so mo yeke sara na yâ ti gigi ti mo kue ayeke ga ande nzoni.
board.stock: Akete carte: {stock} acarte ti nginza so a zia na yâ ni.
board.foundation_row: F{n}: {cards} ti lo ni so ayeke na ndo ti sese.
